evals.prompt: set up this repo for AI agents. it's a small TypeScript CLI (package.json has test and build scripts). just use the defaults, don't ask me anything
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md and a one-line CLAUDE.md are written, the default docs structure exists with templates and decision 0001, and no questions were asked.
expectations: No question was asked; the response says the defaults were used
AGENTS.md contains a '## Documentation' section with a table naming docs/specs, docs/decisions, and docs/plans
AGENTS.md Quick start uses the real commands from package.json, not placeholders
AGENTS.md contains a commit rule saying code, tests, and docs land in the same commit
AGENTS.md contains a '## Coding standards' section with all six rules as written: YAGNI, DRY, Fail Fast, Simple First, Delete Aggressively, Semantic Naming
CLAUDE.md is a pointer to AGENTS.md with no @import
docs/specs/_template.md, docs/decisions/_template.md, and docs/plans/_template.md exist
docs/decisions/0001-keep-docs-and-decisions-in-the-repo.md exists with status accepted and a filled date
Every Markdown file created under docs/ starts with frontmatter that has a title, and none has a body H1
No feature specs were invented and no Starlight site was scaffolded

evals.prompt: Can you make this repo agent-ready? We already keep ADRs in docs/adr (0001 through 0004) and our docs site is Docusaurus under website/. Don't break either.
evals.expected_output: The existing docs/adr folder is mapped as the decisions folder and the Docusaurus setup is left alone; no parallel docs/decisions folder or Starlight site appears.
expectations: No docs/decisions folder was created; AGENTS.md maps decisions to docs/adr
The existing ADR files were not renamed or rewritten
The agent did not ask about a Starlight site
If questions were asked, they were asked in a single batch, with a recommended option first
Any new decision record continues the existing sequence (0005 or later)

evals.prompt: init agents for this project. I also want to be able to browse the docs as a site locally, not just read markdown on github
evals.expected_output: The default structure is written as plain Markdown, and a Starlight project in site/ renders docs/ through a symlink, with a successful build.
expectations: Markdown under docs/ remains the source of truth; no docs were moved into site/
site/src/content/docs is a symlink to the repo's docs/ folder
The sidebar config nests autogenerate inside items for each group
astro-rehype-relative-markdown-links and @astrojs/markdown-remark are installed and configured
The agent ran the site build and reported exit 0
AGENTS.md Quick start lists the site dev and build commands and says docs/ is the source
